claims: Chipotle is offering a "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" Buy-One-Get-One (BOGO) deal on Friday, March 13, 2026.
The "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO deal runs from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM local time.
The "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO deal is available in-restaurant at participating locations in the U.S. and Canada.
Customers with a tattoo (real, temporary, or drawn on) can get a free entree with the purchase of one entree.
Customers show a tattoo (real, temporary, or drawn on with a marker) to the cashier when ordering.
The free item is limited to up to 5 max per customer.
The "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO deal covers burritos, bowls, salads, or tacos, according to USA Today.
The promotion features a custom temporary tattoo sheet designed with artist Swae Lee.
Customers can get the "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO deal by using a sharpie or pen to draw a design on their skin, according to OregonLive.com.
